book.name: Roome
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Bhawloos Roome Eenana Kinin Thaapoono Warqanno

content: Barjo Israveel Eenaam Kinin Kamoono
Kiristooska dahayse gon ida giye, buudimattine. Pir Manpas Gazanbee isa meskenbe ina tarja ke tarje.
Waanka isa muldha maataana imbanaanana gebhi qaabeka atabee kayma qaabebe isa woylaminte gon daane. Kena ashadhayse Kiristooskalanka edimaa i daana ini ida nashe.

Kedi Israveel eenane; Barjoar keam yisa naana ki maasade; yisa gobshinamaar kena ki dhahade; yisa mallanamaar kembesana ki ardade; yisa yigginamaar kena ki imade; goninka goodimadhensa goynam kena ki dhettsisade; kena “Hayayda haye” hamayse kinin giyon upsinam kena ki imade.
Kediar ena wosa eykenakalanka ke nivade; Barjoyn qadhaa Kiristoosaar waanka kisa adhadhidino kesa iirane. Kidi wuldara sagi maataa, rooro wul lay gobshadhaa Barjone; amiin!
Ko dahaannaar Barjosa upsino ookadhoonotehe; harrna hambhidianna, Israveel muldhana wul gon Israveel eeditehe.
Ogodettsi Abraamsa muldhana wul Abraam naanatehe. Barjo Abraamkal: “Hasa muldhanin haapadhayno Yisaaqbarne” ki hamade.
Ogonante waanka adhadhaana Barjo naanatehe; ko dahaannaar gon muldha maatayna Barjo “Hayayda haye” hamayse kinin giyon upsinka adhadhaana eenana bishne.
Ogonoar Barjosa upsino “Niven levensa kaa wodaaka nivayda nive; Saaraar naasi anngi koda adhe” hamaynone.
Ogo bish dayma, wosa eykea Yisaaqkalanka Ribqa naana lamaana mentinam konin sirmon wodanka,

naana mentina ke adhadhima, siyabee payyabeam ke waadadhima birayse, Barjosa kamano waadimaka dayma kisa bhocchindettsi eelimeka konin dohonam dhaana, Barjo Ribqana “Toydia kanaasa waadima eedi kida maate” kona ki hamade.
Ogonoar “Inta Yayqoobam nashidine; Esawam jibbidine” hamayse thaapadhondettsine.
Ta hamino giyo? “Barjo tipa pirdi pirdehe” wo hamo? Hamattone!
Harrna hambhidianna, Barjo Musekal: “Garana inin zageana garayda gare; burqadhana inin zageana burqadhayda burqadhe” ki hamade.
Ogonante Barjosa kamano eedisa bhocchibee eedisa waadimabeka dayma, Barjosa garintonkane.
Ogoka Gibth peen bitaana “Inin haam bitinsoono hanka isa kantanam dhaanabee isa naabeno peen wulir konin giidhoadettsibene” hamayse Mathaap Gazante thaapadhidine.
Ogonante Barjo yi zagidianna gara ki gare; garana yi zagaamma woylaminam duttsa ki duttse.
Barjosa Wacimenbee Garintonbe
“Yin ko hanna, ta koka yekka harrna ki dhiidhime? Barjosa bhocchinam marana damea hayne?” ina hada hame.
Ya ea kaa, Barjobesana palimea ya hayne? Daano “Harrna yin hayayse iam ashkaa?” hamayse daan meesheana hama ko hamo? Hamehe.
Daan meeshea ea dhoqala kalaasa peera antinam gobshadhea koymo, antinam bagadhea koymo hayayse ashkana kisa hayamo qolaaw?
Barjo yisa wacimenam dhaanabee yisa kantanam may dhettsanabe zagayse, kayenna ashkimbhaana wacimen koymonana thoothi kinin darshonam ya haraa dhese?
Ogoam kinin hayoonoar gobshinna birayse kinin ashkaana garinton koymonana yisa gobshinsa wodimmakkonam dhettsanane.
Igina garinton koymonaar wodine. Ayiwd eensa shaarira bish dayma, Ayiwdtay hamma eensa shaariraar woam ki eelade.
Ogonoar Hosev mathaapinte Barjo

content.text: ‘Yedi dehea Barjo naanane’ hamayse keam koda eldhe”

content: ki hamade.
Isiasaar Israveel eenasa yin giyayse kida ilate:

content.text: “Israveel eenasa paydino bazinsa shaamidettsi ko thoothaakaar,
Harrna hambhidianna, Barjo saana peendar dohon eendar shiishima pirdinam kida beve.”

content: Isias ena birayse giyondettsi,

content.text: “Kantan Wul Yisa Dahaa Barjo muldha wona ki shiishaamma,
Sodoombee Gamoorabe katamanadettsi wodi ini kaydine”

content: ki hamade.
Ta hamino giyo? Barjo birante tipa maatana zagaamma Ayiwdtay hamma eena Kiristoosdar woylamin qajintaka Barjo birante tipamonam kedi haapidine.
Ko dahaannaar Barjo birante tipa maasen yigginam zagayna Israveel eena ogo tipa maasen yigginam haapadehe.
Harrnane? Barjo birante tipamonam kenin haapimino Kiristoosdar woylamin qajintaka dayma, kesa waadimanka tipamonam haapana kenin zagonnane. Ogona goan sentaadar ke qanimade;

content.text: “Marrato! Thiyoon gidir eedina goa maatea seeni ida wode;
agaa seeniar eediam dhabea seeni laytane;

content: hamayse thaapadhondettsine.
